name: Minor Illusion
summary: Create an illusory sound or a still image of an object no larger than a 5-foot Cube for 1 minute.
text: Create either a sound or an image of an object within range; it lasts for the duration and ends if you cast this spell again. Sound: anything from a whisper to a scream, such as your voice, someone else's voice, a roar or drumming; it can run continuously or as separate sounds at different moments during the duration. Image: an object such as a chair, muddy footprints or a small chest, no larger than a 5-foot Cube; it makes no sound, light, smell or other sensory effect, and physical contact reveals it as an illusion because things pass through it. A creature that takes the Study action to examine the illusion can make an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC; on a success it knows the illusion for what it is, and the illusion becomes faint to that creature.
